import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def pow_mod(a, p):
    return pow(a, p, MOD)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    if k == 0:
        print(pow_mod(p, p - 1))
        return
    if k == 1:
        print(pow_mod(p, p))
        return
    order = 1
    a = k
    while a != 1:
        a = (a * k) % p
        order += 1
    print(pow_mod(p, (p - 1) // order))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
